messages:
Priya (CSM): Quick heads-up — NovaHealth renewal is slipping into procurement review. They requested a 6mo pilot discount on the annual commit and mentioned PO path. Need alignment on pricing impact and signature flow by EOD Thur. @Liam can you confirm vendor code requirements?
Liam (Procurement): We need vendor code + full billing entity name + tax id to issue PO. CC is possible but they'd prefer PO. If PO, give me the exact invoice entity string.
Priya (CSM): Billing entity is 'NovaHealth Holdings, Inc.' — tax id on file but will confirm. Pricing for 6mo pilot: current approved rate is $0.009/token; requested 20% off for first 6mo. That reduces committed ARR impact.
Jules (Legal): If discount changes contract language (term/consideration), finance/legal want the amendment written. Any DP/ToS changes?
Priya (CSM): No DP changes. It's only a term/pricing amendment + signature. I'll attach the requested SOW edits in this thread in a sec.
onboarding-bot: A draft SOW file was uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/novah-health-sow-draft.pdf
Marco (Enablement): If they take the 6mo pilot we'll need a condensed enablement plan: 90-min kickoff + 1 follow-up office hour. I can run sessions week of 4/7. Do we need extra training credits?
Liam (Procurement): Confirmed — PO team needs the SOW title exactly as it appears on the invoice. Also, if finance flags ARR, we might need a signed amendment rather than just an email.
Jules (Legal): Upload the amendment skeleton here. If it's purely a pricing addendum (no new obligations), we can fast-track. Priya, can you confirm: are they asking to reduce the committed term or just discount the first 6 months of a 12mo commit?
Priya (CSM): They're asking discount on months 1–6, still committed 12mo. So no term shortening.
Jules (Legal): Good — that helps. I'll prepare a 1-page amendment with pricing table and signatory block. Please review before I send.
Priya (CSM): @Liam can you confirm vendor code + whether PO will include 'NovaHealth Holdings, Inc.' exactly? We need PO by next Tue to hit EOM billing.
Liam (Procurement): I'll ping their procurement lead. ETA Tue COB. I'll post PO number here once received.
Marco (Enablement): Tentative kickoff: Tue 4/8 10am PT or Thu 4/10 9am PT. Which works for Nova? Priya, do you have customer preference?
Priya (CSM): I'll ask. Planning note: if PO delays past Tue we might provision with interim invoice on CC and reconcile once PO arrives. Ops OK with that?
Liam (Procurement): Ops can do interim CC invoice if finance signs off — prefer PO but we can fallback. Please include that option in amendment language.
Jules (Legal): Will do. I'll mark the amendment draft 'expedite' and share for review by tomorrow morning.
Priya (CSM): Great — action items: Priya confirm SOW edits + customer preference on kickoff; Liam chase PO/vendor code; Jules draft amendment; Marco prep condensed enablement plan. I'll follow up and post updates here. :thumbsup:
Liam (Procurement): Got it. I'll update thread with PO number and vendor code.
onboarding-bot: Kickoff session placeholder created in calendar: "NovaHealth Enablement - Tentative".
Priya (CSM): Thanks all — tagging back once I hear from Nova.
